title: The Geography of Power: Centralized States, Decentralized States, and the Primate City
dek: A country’s political structure is often visible on its map.

title: I Realized Oil Is an Economic Problem, Not a Geological One.
dek: Why a barrel of oil that technically exists underground can still be worth nothing, and how that quirk of geology quietly shapes U.S.–Saudi relations.

title: Why Even Superpowers Can’t Win Wars Anymore
dek: Military rankings feel almost absurd nowadays, right? Russia sits at number two, the US at number one undisputed. And yet both are visibly struggling to break the spirit of comparatively small nations like Ukraine and Iran. So what the hell is going on?
